title: Gold vs property in India: gold up 7x since 2010, but does property ever fall?
description:
Gold 24K went from about ₹18,500 per 10 g (2010 average) to about ₹1,36,950 on 16 Nov 2026, yet fell ₹1,690 in one weekend. RBI's House Price Index for 18 cities fell 0.6% in Q2 2025-26 (113.4 to 112.7) and was up 3.6% a year in Q1 2026-27. Rent, liquidity and stamp duty change the comparison.

Sources: BankBazaar, Goodreturns via HDFC Sky, RBI HPI via PTI and ANI. Gold prices are bullion rates before taxes and making charges. Some scenes are AI visualisation. Educational content, not investment advice.
